Modems are categorized by baud rate. Baud rate is the amount of information sent over the phone line in a second. Baud rate is measured in Bits Per Second. Most often bps is used when discussing modem speed...

While most modems run on analog phone lines, there is also another type of modem that runs on a digital phone line. This modem is called an ISDN modem. ISDN modems are almost twice as fast as analog modems...

While most modems run on analog phone lines, there is also another type of modem that runs on a digital phone line. This modem is called an ISDN modem. ISDN modems are almost twice as fast as analog modems...

ISDN - Integrated Services Digital Network. This modem, also known as a BRI (Basic Rate Interchange) line, uses two data channels. These channels can operate separately or jointly. Separately, the channels run independent of each other and can be used for either voice or data communications. In the dual configuration, both channels are used for data which doubles the transmission speed. However, in this configuration, no voice is available.
